_readme: Gatherable resource nodes. Each is a fixed spawn point on the island; gathering it grants one of its item type and puts it on a respawn cooldown (timing is per-type, set in resources.go). Positions are world coordinates (0..1280, 0..720); driftwood along the sandy shore, scrap iron (rusted wreck-iron) near the dock and waterline. See docs/lore/README.md.
